svg.title: Trumpet-profile bell - 67 rings of 1 ply, 201mm built on a 201mm profile, 25mm square throat to 129.0mm square rim
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Bessel horn, gamma 0.7, throat ø25 to rim ø129.0mm over 201mm. Each ring is 1 lamination(s) of 3mm ply, 3mm of rise, lapping the ring below by 3.0mm.
